findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nodus_ara, nodus_anlamsal_ara, nodus_sayfa, nodus_hizmetler · Private data: nodus_entegrasyonlar, nodus_iletisim · Public sink: nodus_hizmetler, nodus_iletisim, nodus_toplanti_talebi.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nodus_ara, nodus_anlamsal_ara, nodus_sayfa, nodus_hizmetler · Private data: nodus_entegrasyonlar, nodus_iletisim · Public sink: nodus_hizmetler, nodus_iletisim, nodus_toplanti_talebi

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
